quarterly_data.quarter: Fujifilm press release: Fujifilm Reinforces Production Facilities for instax  Films (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujifilm will invest 3 billion JPY in new instax film production lines at the Ashigara Site of its Kanagawa Factory in Japan, starting operation in stages from spring 2027 and fully operational from spring 2028, raising instax film production capacity by approximately 20% versus FY2026 (approximately 70% versus FY2022, as Fujifilm has expanded instax film capacity since 2022). instax sales reached 200 billion JPY in FY2025, a fifth consecutive record year since FY2021, and cumulative instax product sales surpassed 100 million units by the end of FY2024.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 billion JPY investment; capacity +20% vs FY2026; instax sales 200 billion JPY (FY2025)
